columns.t_s: seconds since the first sample of the session
columns.arduino_ms: Arduino clock at the sample (ms since reset)
columns.pc_time: computer clock when the sample arrived
columns.indicator: Schmitt trigger: 1 from corrected >= upper until corrected <= lower
columns.ttl: TTL input level at the sample
columns.ttl_count: TTL pulses since the session started (= camera frame number, 1 pulse/frame)
